items.claim: Amanda Lemos will lack the space and distance across three rounds to do enough to beat Alexa Grasso.
items.quote: I just don't see her having the space and distance across a full three rounds to be able to do enough to beat Alexa Grasso.

items.claim: Ty Miller has cleaner and more straightforward striking compared to Trey Waters.
items.quote: I think Ty Miller is a step ahead of Trey Waters in the striking. I think he's much more clean overall.

items.claim: Trey Waters has poor defensive striking with a tall man's defense keeping his head up.
items.quote: Trey Waters, he's a tall lengthy striker. I don't like Trey Waters striking defense. You know, he's just one of these guys he has the tall man's defense. He keeps his head all the way up.

items.claim: Ty Miller is going to keep his fight against Billy Ray Goff standing.
items.quote: Ty Miller is going to keep this fight standing.

items.claim: Bruno Lopes is a BJJ black belt who can submit Diur Nurgaze if he takes the fight to the ground.
items.quote: What is Bruno Lopes? A BJJ black belt. 1 + 1 = 2 here. If Bruno Lopes can take this fight to the ground, he should be able to submit Diur Nurgaze

items.claim: Diur Nurgaze has poor submission defense.
items.quote: With Diur Nurgaze, where is his main issue? Where is his main struggle? Where does the man really kind of [ __ ] the bed? With the grappling. The man's submission defense is no bueno.

items.claim: Bruno Lopes has chin concerns if the fight stays on the feet.
items.quote: Bruno Lopes' chin is no bueno either. So, we have a real chin concern versus a real submission defense concern
